entries.title: Psalms 88:1
segments: A Song. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. To the Chief Musician. On Mahalath, to make humble. A Poem of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before You.

entries.title: Psalms 88:2
segments: Let my prayer come before You; bow down Your ear to my cry.

entries.title: Psalms 88:3
segments: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near the grave.

entries.title: Psalms 88:4
segments: I am counted with those who go down to the Pit; I am like a feeble man;

entries.title: Psalms 88:5
segments: free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom You remember no more; and by Your hand they are cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 88:6
segments: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

entries.title: Psalms 88:7
segments: Your wrath lies hard on me, and You have afflicted [me] with all Your waves. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 88:8
segments: You have taken my friends away from me; You have made me a hateful thing to them. [I am] shut up, and I cannot go out.

entries.title: Psalms 88:9
segments: My eye mourns because of affliction; O LORD, I have called daily on You; I have stretched out my hands to You.

entries.title: Psalms 88:10
segments: For will You do wonders to the dead? Shall the dead rise [and] praise You? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 88:11
segments: Shall Your loving-kindness be declared in the grave? [Or] Your faithfulness in ruin?

entries.title: Psalms 88:12
segments: Shall Your wonders be known in the dark, and Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

entries.title: Psalms 88:13
segments: But to You I have cried, O LORD; and in the morning my prayer shall go before You.

entries.title: Psalms 88:14
segments: O LORD, why do You cast off my soul? [Why] do You hide Your face from me?

entries.title: Psalms 88:15
segments: I [am] afflicted and ready to die from my youth up; while I suffer Your terrors, I pine away.

entries.title: Psalms 88:16
segments: Your fierce wrath goes over me; Your terrors have cut me off.

entries.title: Psalms 88:17
segments: They surrounded me like waters all the day long; they have come together around me.

entries.title: Psalms 88:18
segments: You have taken lover and friend far from me, [and] those who know me into darkness.
